messages.content: Do you get defensive when someone disagrees with you?
Less than I used to, honestly. I think my first reaction is still a small flinch, but I've gotten better at actually hearing the disagreement before deciding whether to fight it.
Realizing how many times I was right to update my mind once I actually listened. That's kind of the only cure for defensiveness - proof it pays off.
